meta_description:
166 likes, 2 comments - fintaxbynishant on September 8, 2026: "One financial decisions you make today can shape your kid’s future.

Starting early gives you something every parent needs, TIME.

I’ve explained the complete process in this reel so you can make the right decision from the beginning.

Steps to open account

1. Minor Mutual Fund Folio open karo
Baby mutual fund folio ka sole holder hota hai, aur parent/legal guardian uske behalf par account operate karta hai.

2. Required KYC & documents complete karo
Baby aur parent/legal guardian ke required documents submit karne hote hain. Exact documentation aur onboarding process AMC/platform ke according different ho sakta hai.

3. SIP start karo
SEBI ke applicable rules ke according, investment ka payment minor ke bank account, parent/legal guardian ke bank account, ya eligible joint account se kiya ja sakta hai. Lekin platform ka payment process alag ho sakta hai, isliye SIP start karne se pehle uske rules check kar lena.

4. Minor ka bank account rakhna practical hai
Baby ke naam par bank account hona SIP start karne ke liye universally compulsory nahi hai. Lekin future mein redemption ka paisa minor ke verified bank account mein hi credit hota hai. Isliye minor ka bank account pehle se open karwana practical rahega.

5. 18 saal ke baad process change hota hai
Child ke 18 saal ka hone par folio ko Minor se Major status mein update karna hota hai. KYC aur bank details update hone tak guardian ke through further transactions nahi kiye ja sakte.

One important thing: Har AMC/platform ka onboarding process aur available payment options alag ho sakte hain. Isliye account open karne se pehle Minor Mutual Fund Folio support aur current requirements zaroor check karna.
.
.
.
[child financial planning, minor mutual fund folio, baby investment, child education fund, wealth creation for children, mutual fund sip, financial planning for parents, long term investing, investment planning, parenting finance]

#futureplanning #newparents #wealthbuilding #moneyhabits #financialgoals".
